name: Amazon Ancient Ruins
coordinateSystem: x/z in LEGO stud pitches; y is bottom elevation; one brick = 1.2 units; one plate = 0.4 units

transformGoal.completionRule: 420/420 regular inventory slots must have instruction-page provenance and exact position/orientation transforms

sourceNotes: Gateway placements tagged manual-page-28/manual-page-30 are tied directly to instruction scans.
Car chassis/axle/wheel placements tagged instruction-page-7/instruction-page-8 use local subassembly transforms tied to the manual.
A community LDD 4.3.8 reconstruction by penguinz is retained only as a geometry cross-check; it substitutes the Sun Disc and raised baseplate and lacks correct decorations.
Main temple, trap platform, boat and the remainder of the car remain inventory-bounded reconstructions until their instruction pages are transcribed.
All regular-part usage is validated against the BrickLink 172-lot / 420-part inventory snapshot in this repository.
The deterministic transform and page ledgers prevent CAD/photo geometry from being mislabeled as instruction-exact.
